Repo portrait/gym art provenance not recorded. No new AI art generated; walkout/bell/crowd are procedural stand-ins. Mocks used today's 8 rail items (J54 landed after the mocks were made). All words EXAMPLE for Kalli. Wait for operator direction pick before building.
